[[File:SavageStar-TJP.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Savage Star fighter]]
The '''Savage Star fighter''' was a model of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was used by the [[Jedi Starfighter Corps]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[New Sith Wars]]. The [[Jedi ace]] [[Crix Sunburris]] considered the Savage Star to be favored by members of the Corps over the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat]] [[Redshift]], a fighter used during the conflict with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Savage Stars were fitted with twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], an external [[hyperdrive sled]] and a [[Chempat Shield Generator|Chempat deflector shield]].<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Savage Star fighter appeared in the [[2010]] book [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']] and was illustrated by [[Jeffery Carlisle]].<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force" />
